request.action_description: Hit 2, continuing from the follow-through of hit 1: DYNAMIC, powerful slash with full body weight thrown forward: a deep lunge step, hips and shoulders rotating into the swing, the torso leaning forward, the sword sweeping in a wide arc in front of the body at full arm extension; strong anticipation windup and a sharp follow-through. This slash sweeps the opposite way (reverse backhand). Sword in the right hand. Front foot forward, back foot braced, NO bow-legged or crab stance. The cape flows with the body. Long straight hair, only the ends sway. Gold pauldron on the left shoulder. Face and outfit identical to the idle. Bold outlines, no flickering pixels. NO slash trail, glow, sparks or any effects. No glow, sparks, flashes or energy effects. Keep facing the camera the whole time.
